svg.title: Measuring the four paths of the coupled vessels
svg.desc: A 5-point step of heater 1 raises vessel 1 by 0.690 and vessel 2 by 0.306 degrees Celsius; a step of heater 2 raises vessel 2 by 0.688 and vessel 1 by 0.304 degrees. At the end of each step 3.08 kilowatts cross the wall from the warmer vessel. Control Studio's measured gain matrix is 0.1380 and 0.0607 in the first row and 0.0611 and 0.1376 in the second, in degrees per point.
svg.text: Measuring the four paths of the coupled vessels
Control Studio recording of this project · a 5-point step of each heater with the other fixed · numbers answer the predictions
